# STLACCESS — Privacy-First STL Tools That Run in Your Browser

> STLACCESS is a suite of free, browser-based STL utilities: an STL Viewer, an STL Scale Inspector, an STL Converter, and an STL Printability Checker. Every tool is 100% client-side — files are never uploaded, there is no account, no cookie banner, and no installation. The site is static (built with Astro) and each tool works offline after the first page load. The brand is **STLACCESS**.

## The four tools

| Tool | URL | What it does | Status |
|------|-----|--------------|--------|
| STL Scale Inspector | https://stlaccess.com/stl-scale-inspector/ | Check what size an STL will print at. Pick source and target scale for the exact slicer percentage, or drop in an STL to read its real X/Y/Z dimensions in millimetres and inches and calculate a target-height percentage. 16 tabletop scales, eye-level/top-of-head measurement, shrinkage compensation, copy-to-clipboard, deep-linkable URL parameters. | Live |
| STL Viewer | https://stlaccess.com/stl-viewer/ | Open binary and ASCII STL files in 3D with WebGL. Orbit, pan, zoom, wireframe, and read the exact bounding box. No upload, no install. | Live |
| STL Converter | https://stlaccess.com/stl-converter/ | Convert STL to OBJ, ASCII PLY, binary STL, or ASCII STL locally in the browser. Adjustable vertex merge tolerance. No upload limits because there is no upload, no watermarks, no account. | Live |
| STL Printability Checker | https://stlaccess.com/stl-printability-checker/ | Pre-slice mesh validation: open edges, non-manifold edges, inconsistent winding, degenerate triangles, disconnected shells, plus bounding box, volume, and surface area. Adjustable merge tolerance. Runs locally. | Live |

## The privacy guarantee

These are the facts the site is built around, stated plainly so they can be quoted:

- **No upload.** There is no upload endpoint. Files are read locally by the page and never sent to a server.
- **No account, no login, no paywall.** Every tool is free.
- **No cookies, no consent banner.** The only analytics is an anonymous, cookie-free pageview counter that stores no identifier, no IP address, and nothing on the visitor's device (disclosed in the privacy policy).
- **Works offline.** After the first page load, tools continue to run with no connection.
- **Verifiable claim.** Open the browser's network tab while using a tool: no file bytes are transmitted.

## Scale-inspector math

The scale inspector uses a **175cm human baseline**, measured to **eye level (160cm)** by default.

- **Gaming/display scales** (28mm, 32mm, 35mm, 40mm, 75mm, 6mm, 8mm, 10mm, 30mm, 15mm) are measured to **eye level**.
- **Ratio scales** (1:35, 1:27, 1:48, 1:56, 1:72, 1:100) are measured to the **top of the head**.
- **Formula:** `(target standard mm ÷ source standard mm) × 100 = slicer percentage`.

Canonical examples: 28mm → 32mm = **114.3%** (top-of-head variant 116.1%); 32mm → 28mm = **87.5%**; 1:35 → 1:56 = **62.5%**; 1:100 → 28mm = **160.0%**; 32mm → 75mm = **234.4%**. The eye-to-top-of-head gap (~15cm) creates a **5–10%** difference in calculated scale.

### Common conversions

| From | To | Slicer % | Top-of-Head % |
|------|----|----------|---------------|
| 28mm | 32mm | 114.3% | 116.1% |
| 28mm | 35mm | 125.0% | — |
| 28mm | 40mm | 142.9% | — |
| 28mm | 75mm | 267.9% | — |
| 32mm | 28mm | 87.5% | 95.4% |
| 32mm | 35mm | 109.4% | — |
| 32mm | 40mm | 125.0% | — |
| 32mm | 75mm | 234.4% | — |
| 35mm | 28mm | 80.0% | — |
| 35mm | 32mm | 91.4% | — |
| 1:100 | 28mm | 160.0% | — |
| 1:100 | 32mm | 182.9% | — |
| 1:35 | 28mm | 56.0% | 61.3% |
| 1:35 | 32mm | 64.0% | — |
| 1:48 | 28mm | 76.8% | — |
| 1:48 | 32mm | 87.8% | — |
| 1:56 | 28mm | 89.6% | — |
| 1:56 | 32mm | 102.4% | — |
| 1:72 | 28mm | 115.2% | — |
| 1:72 | 32mm | 131.7% | — |

Machine-readable open data (CC BY 4.0): [scale-baselines.json](https://stlaccess.com/data/scale-baselines.json) / [.csv](https://stlaccess.com/data/scale-baselines.csv), [conversion-matrix.json](https://stlaccess.com/data/conversion-matrix.json), [fdm-profiles.json](https://stlaccess.com/data/fdm-profiles.json), and [index.json](https://stlaccess.com/data/index.json).

## How the site is built

- Astro (static site generation), Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, content collections
- No backend, no database, no user accounts
- All tool logic runs client-side in JavaScript/WebGL
- Sitemap and RSS generated at build time
- Source on GitHub: [kitsorix-official/stlaccess](https://github.com/kitsorix-official/stlaccess)

## Editing conventions

- **Brand:** always STLACCESS.
- **Tool names:** STL Viewer, STL Scale Inspector, STL Converter, STL Printability Checker.
- **Privacy claims must stay literally true.** Do not call a tool "no upload" unless the file is processed entirely client-side. Do not claim a tool is live before it is.
- **Numbers:** derive from the 175cm/160cm baseline and the formula above; changes must be verified against `scaleBaselines.json` / `conversionMatrix.json` / `fdmProfiles.json`.
- **Voice:** first-person hobbyist, plain English.
- **Build check:** `npm run build` must stay green.

## About the operator

STLACCESS is a free, independent project built and maintained by one person who has been 3D printing since 2017, including a stint running a commercial print service in Enschede, Netherlands. Percentages are verified with FDM test prints on a Bambu Lab A1 Mini and a PARKSIDE digital caliper (0.01mm resolution). Donation-funded, no accounts, no paywall.
